units.source_text: 说来世奇怪，当时我并不认为那是犯罪的行为，因为在我的记忆里踩踏女人的行为渐渐生出了光辉。

en.t: Strangely enough, at the time I did not think of it as a criminal act, because in my memory the act of trampling on the woman had gradually begun to shine.

units.source_text: 不仅是因为我知道结果女人流产了。

en.t: It was not only because I knew that, as a result, the woman had miscarried.

units.source_text: 那种行为恍如金沙似地沉淀在我的记忆里，永远放肘出刺眼的光芒。

en.t: That act settled in my memory like gold dust, forever giving off a dazzling glare.

units.source_text: 不错，纵令是细小的罪恶，但罪恶的意识是明确的。

en.t: Yes, even if it was a small sin, the consciousness of sin was clear.

units.source_text: 不觉间我具备了这种意识。

en.t: Without realizing it, I had acquired that consciousness.

units.source_text: 它就像勋章那样挂在我的心底里。

en.t: It hung in the depths of my heart like a medal.
